preludes.reason: Household size is not present as a single household-level column; it must be counted from the person roster and then used to normalize total household disposable income (HG110) to a per-capita welfare aggregate.
invariants: One row per hh_id present in silc24_h

bindings.evidence: Derived by counting silc24_p.pers_id rows per silc24_p.hh_id; no household-size column found in silc24_h (searches). Evidence: silc24_p schema and hh_id/pers_id keys. (t2, t7, t11)
Per-capita welfare constructed as Total household disposable income (silc24_h.hg110) divided by derived household size. hg110 is explicitly a disposable income aggregate (HG110). (t8)
Nominal welfare set equal to per-capita disposable income (HG110 / hsize); no separate deflated series provided. (t8)
Shared prosperity welfare set to same underlying per-capita disposable income aggregate (HG110 / hsize). (t8)
Survey welfare aggregate source is labelled 'Total household disposable income' (silc24_h.hg110), i.e., an income concept. (t8)
Shared prosperity aggregate is set equal to the same income aggregate as welfare (HG110 / hsize), so type is income. (t8)
